chunks: And it is narrated from Zurarah that he said:
Abu Ja'far عليه السلام said: “All qunut is recited aloud.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام, the authority quoted in the hadith
key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: the supplication recited in salat at the designated place
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurarah, the narrator transmitting this report

ai.seo_question: Should qunut in salat be recited aloud or silently?
ai.summary: This hadith states a ruling about qunut in salat, indicating that it is to be recited aloud. It is a brief fiqh report from Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام concerning the manner of performing this act of worship.
